overview: The Sunken Observatory is a collapsed Combine arcane research complex buried beneath the Twilight Sea. It once monitored planar activity across Luclin.
history: The Observatory was built during the height of the Combine Empire.
It monitored planar anomalies across Luclin, especially the Twilight Sea.
A catastrophic resonance event shattered the complex and sank it.
Siren Courts later discovered the ruin and began harvesting its arcane residue.
Elemental anomalies now pulse through the flooded chambers.
hooks: Siren raiders attempt to seize a Combine vault.
Elemental pressure pockets destabilize the lower halls.
A Combine arcane core is discovered deep within the ruin.
